title: Pricing
description: Three plans and a billing switch. The middle plan carries the decision; the rest is context.
usage: Prices live in data-m (monthly) and data-y (yearly) on each amount; the switch swaps them, only inside its own .pricing section, so several pricing sections can share a page. Rewire the amounts, keep the rhythm. The switch fires a native change event.
a11y: The billing switch is a labelled checkbox (Yearly billing). Changing it updates this section's prices and a status region announces monthly or yearly prices. A checked state restored by the browser shows matching prices. Screen-reader output is not yet verified by hand.
